themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe continue to advocate for policies that prioritize native citizens over immigrants, often framing these as 'national priority' measures. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, France, Sweden, and the UK, with parties like Vox, Lega, Rassemblement National, Sverigedemokraterna, and Reform UK leading the charge. The policies range from redirecting funds from international cooperation to local social services, to criticizing multicultural symbols like the Ukrainian flag.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Redirects funds from international cooperation to local social services, emphasizing 'national priority' in budget allocations.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for policies favoring Italian citizens in housing and social services, often clashing with EU migration policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Promotes strict immigration controls and national preference in welfare, aligning with broader far-right European trends.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Pushes for policies that prioritize Swedish citizens in welfare and housing, often criticizing multiculturalism.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Advocates for removing Ukrainian flags from council buildings, emphasizing British symbols over multicultural ones.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei faces growing internal divisions within his party, La Libertad Avanza, and declining public approval. Key figures like Patricia Bullrich and Manuel Adorni are at odds with Milei’s policies, while judicial investigations into alleged corruption further strain his administration. This theme resonates in the US, Italy, and Spain, where Milei’s libertarian policies are both praised and criticized.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal conflicts between Milei, Bullrich, and Adorni over policy direction and judicial investigations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Milei’s libertarian policies are both praised and criticized by US conservatives, reflecting ideological alignment.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Milei’s economic policies are debated in Italy, with some praising his free-market reforms and others criticizing their social impact.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox aligns with Milei’s anti-socialist rhetoric but criticizes his handling of internal party conflicts.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are making significant gains in local elections, reflecting a broader trend of growing support for nationalist and anti-establishment platforms. This theme is evident in Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden, and the UK, where parties like AfD, Fratelli d'Italia, Vox, Sverigedemokraterna, and Reform UK are securing victories in municipal and regional elections.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in several regions, securing victories in local elections and gaining influence in state parliaments.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Wins key mayoral races in Lecco, Arezzo, and Macerata, consolidating power in local governments.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Gains seats in regional parliaments, influencing coalition negotiations in Andalusia and Castilla y León.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Increases its share of local council seats, particularly in southern Sweden, where it holds significant influence.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Secures council seats in Birmingham and other cities, challenging traditional Conservative and Labour strongholds.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, often centered around leadership disputes, ideological differences, and strategic disagreements. This theme is evident in Poland, Hungary, the UK, Italy, and France, where parties like PiS, Fidesz, Reform UK, Lega, and Rassemblement National face challenges to their unity.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Faces leadership disputes between Kaczyński and Nawrocki, with factions disagreeing on policy direction.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Internal conflicts between Orbán loyalists and reformists like Péter Magyar over corruption and governance.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Struggles with internal dissent over Farage’s leadership and policy positions, leading to defections.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega faces leadership challenges from Salvini’s rivals, including Zaia and Vannacci, over party direction.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Internal disagreements over pension reforms and leadership succession between Le Pen and Bardella.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and leaders across the globe are reacting to escalating conflicts in the Middle East, often aligning with Israel and criticizing Iran and Palestinian groups. This theme is evident in the US, Argentina, Italy, Poland, and France, where parties like MAGA, La Libertad Avanza, Fratelli d'Italia, PiS, and Rassemblement National are shaping their foreign policy stances around these conflicts.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Strongly supports Israel, criticizes Iran, and frames Middle East conflicts as existential threats to Western civilization.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Aligns closely with Israel, hosting events honoring Jewish leaders and strengthening military ties with the US.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports Israel and criticizes Iran, often framing Middle East conflicts as part of a broader clash of civilizations.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes Iran and supports Israel, often linking Middle East conflicts to broader geopolitical threats.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Supports Israel and criticizes Iran, often framing Middle East conflicts as threats to European security.
